title: The Brownish Yellow
subtitle: A deep brownish-yellow cushion, warm as late light, held between two half-moons.

stone.origin: GIA-graded. Centre: 5.38 ct, 11.35 x 9.74 x 6.32 mm. Flanked by two half-moon side diamonds (1.25 ct TW).

editorial: Fancy Deep Brownish Yellow is one of the rarest colour grades the GIA records — a hue this saturated appears in fewer than one in ten thousand diamonds. The centre stone weighs 5.38 carats, cushion-cut, 11.35 × 9.74 mm face-up, flanked by two matched half-moon side diamonds. Total weight 6.63 carats. Set in 18K gold or platinum, made to specification in Los Angeles.
description: A cushion of deep brownish-yellow sits at the centre, its colour warm and low like the last hour of daylight — not the bright lemon of a fancy yellow but something closer to amber and cognac. Two half-moon diamonds hold it from either side, their straight edges framing the round warmth cleanly and passing white light back into the centre. The setting keeps everything quiet around that colour, letting the stone's unusual, smoky warmth carry the ring. Made in eighteen-karat gold or platinum.
